title: AC1018 HATCH inactive-gradient stop DXF loss guard
scope: Prevent silent loss when a parsed DWG HATCH has isGradient=0 but retains gradient color stops. The DXF writer emits the gradient block only for active gradients, while DXF validation requires the disabled-gradient stop count to be zero. The guard refuses this unrepresentable profile and leaves the caller's entity available for an explicitly corrected retry.

authority.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.relevance: ODA lists the R2004+ gradient flag, companion fields, stop count and each stop's value/CMC fields in the HATCH body. No change to the DWG byte layout or parser was made.

physicalSource.repositoryStatus: external local sample; not added to this repository
physicalSource.localReaderResult: PASS: current libdxfrw imports HATCH 0x173 with isGradient=0, two stop values 0/1, C2 colors 0x0000FF/0xFFFFFF, and two type-7 polyline paths with two vertices and bulge 1.0 on each vertex.
physicalSource.readDisposition: The source import reports 474 entity parse failures elsewhere in the drawing. This checks one typed record only and does not qualify whole-file output.

independentProjection.observation: The peer projection identifies HATCH handle [0,2,371], is_gradient_fill=0, two stops at 0/1 with C2 colors 0x0000FF/0xFFFFFF, and two derived closed polyline paths with two vertices, bulge 1.0 and no boundary handles. This is corroborative implementation evidence, not normative layout authority.

implementation.change: DRW_Hatch::validateDxf rejects isGradient=0 when gradColors is nonempty. Both HATCH and MPOLYGON writers use validation before emission; DRW_MPolygon::validateDxf delegates to the HATCH validation.
implementation.behavior: Refuse the projection instead of dropping retained stop data. No DWG parser, DWG writer, public API, or DRW_Interface callback changed.

coverage: Ordinary ASCII and Binary HATCH baseline output and typed readback
Nonempty stops with isGradient=0 are refused in both encodings
Existing destination bytes remain unchanged on refusal
After the caller clears the unsupported stops, the same exporter succeeds and fresh typed readback finds the HATCH

affectedCohort.asanRun: Not run; this validation-only writer guard changes no allocation, ownership, parser bounds, or lifetime behavior.

limitations: This guard does not determine whether the inactive stops have native rendering meaning; that remains independently unqualified.
The source drawing has unrelated entity parse failures and was not converted as a whole.
Selected HATCH import and generated refusal/readback controls do not qualify general HATCH, MPOLYGON, geometry, annotation, or consumer support.
No external DWG/DXF fixture was added and no support claim is promoted.
